_about: Measurements and medical contacts that astronauts on long-duration ISS missions (~6 months) are CONFIRMED to have during flight, with frequency and source. Only items whose in-flight frequency is stated in a cited source are in 'confirmed'. Items we could not confirm are in 'not_confirmed' — do not present them as fact. The official schedule documents (ISS MORD / MRID) are not public, so frequencies come from NASA papers and presentations. Notation: FD = flight day, R-x = days before return.

schedule_types.every_n_days: repeat every 'every_days' days, starting at 'start_fd' if given
schedule_types.mission_days: on listed flight days (FDxx) or days before return (R-xx)

confirmed.name: Private Medical Conference (PMC)
confirmed.what: Private status update with the crew's flight surgeon: symptoms, medical events, how countermeasures are going. Findings go into the electronic health record.
confirmed.app_role: Weekly summary report generated by the app and sent (asynchronously, with comm delay) to the flight surgeon.
app_inputs: all indicator statuses for the week

confirmed.name: Private Psychological Conference (PPC)
confirmed.what: 15–20 min talk with a NASA psychiatrist/psychologist, usually at the weekend.
topics: sleep duration and quality, sleep-shift issues
preparation for major events such as EVA
confirmed.app_role: Bi-weekly psych self-check built from the PPC topic list.

confirmed.name: WinSCAT neurocognitive assessment
confirmed.what: Short computerized cognitive test that tracks the astronaut against their own preflight baseline (detects decline from fatigue, CO2, injury).
confirmed.app_role: Monthly reminder + short in-app reaction-time / attention test compared with personal baseline.

confirmed.name: Periodic Fitness Evaluation (PFE)
confirmed.what: Submaximal cycle-ergometer test (25–75% VO2max) to estimate aerobic capacity; heart rate, ECG and blood pressure recorded.
confirmed.equipment: CEVIS cycle ergometer, BP/ECG monitor, heart-rate monitor
confirmed.app_role: Reminder on FD15 and every 30 days; log estimated VO2max → vo2max_pct_baseline threshold.

confirmed.name: Exercise countermeasures (ARED resistive, T2 treadmill, CEVIS cycle)
confirmed.what: Prevents bone, muscle and aerobic loss. Tracked as session duration, average/peak heart rate, loads and repetitions.
confirmed.equipment: ARED (11–272 kg), T2 treadmill, CEVIS cycle

schedule.note: ~1.5–2 h/day scheduled (2.5 h incl. setup), ~600 min/week

confirmed.app_role: Daily exercise log → exercise_minutes_daily threshold; feeds projected BMD loss rate (with vs without ARED).

confirmed.name: Ocular / SANS examination
confirmed.what: Optic disc swelling and retinal thickness (OCT), globe flattening and optic nerve sheath (ultrasound), fundus images, intraocular pressure, visual acuity.
confirmed.equipment: ISS OCT, ultrasound, tonometer, eye charts
confirmed.self_performed: crew-operated with ground guidance; visual acuity can be self-checked
confirmed.app_role: Reminders on FD30 / FD90 / R-30; between exams a quick vision self-check questionnaire; any vision change → escalate.

confirmed.name: Crew Passive Dosimeter
confirmed.what: Personal absorbed dose and dose equivalent; worn by each US crew member throughout the flight including EVA; read out after return.
confirmed.equipment: Crew Passive Dosimeter (TLD/OSLD/PNTD); area monitors in modules
confirmed.self_performed: wearing: yes; no real-time readout to crew
confirmed.app_role: App fills the real-time gap: accumulate dose from environment dose rate + live NOAA proton alerts → radiation_career_mSv, solar_proton_flux_10MeV.
confirmed.note: Neutrons make up ~30% of total ISS radiation (CSA); CSA is developing CANS for continuous autonomous neutron measurement.

confirmed.name: Cabin environment monitoring (CO2, O2, combustion products, noise, water, microbes)
confirmed.what: CO2 and O2 partial pressure, noise dose, water quality and microbial sampling. CO2 is linked to headaches (each +1 mmHg ≈ doubles odds).
confirmed.equipment: CO2 monitors (CDM), CSA-O2/CP, acoustic dosimeter, water kits, microbial air sampler

schedule.note: portable monitors used continuously or on request; sampling kits periodically

confirmed.app_role: Show cabin readings next to symptoms (headache, poor sleep) → cabin_co2, cabin_ppo2, cabin_temperature, cabin_humidity, noise_24h.

confirmed_research_standard_measures._about: Spaceflight Standard Measures — NASA research protocol run on ISS since 2018 for crew members who consent (not mandatory medical care). Frequencies confirmed by NTRS sources.

items.name: Wrist actigraphy + daily sleep log
items.what: Activity per minute, light exposure, sleep timing and duration.

items.name: Sleep quality / team questionnaire (tablet)
items.what: Sleep, mood, affect, team cohesion, habitability.

items.name: NASA Cognition battery (10 subtests incl. psychomotor vigilance)
items.what: Memory, attention, abstraction, spatial orientation, emotion recognition, risk decision-making, sensorimotor speed, vigilant attention.

items.name: Blood biochemistry (CBC, metabolic and chemistry panels)
items.what: Blood counts, glucose, electrolytes, kidney and liver markers. Samples frozen and analyzed on the ground.
items.app_role: Lab results tab; demo values from Inspiration4 CSVs with lab reference ranges.

items.name: Cellular profile (blood + saliva)
items.what: Stress hormones, latent virus reactivation, immune cell types.

items.name: Microbiome (body swabs, saliva, stool)
items.what: Microbes on and in the body.

not_confirmed.name: Body mass (SLAMMD / BMMD)
not_confirmed.issue: Device and typical loss (−2…5%) confirmed; routine in-flight frequency not stated in any public source.

not_confirmed.name: On-Orbit Hearing Assessment
not_confirmed.issue: 'Within FD14, then every 60 days' comes only from a 2012 report; current cadence unconfirmed.

not_confirmed.name: Operational (clinical, non-research) in-flight blood/urine draws
not_confirmed.issue: Sampling days not public; on-board blood analyzer and urine strips are used as needed.

not_confirmed.name: Routine BP/ECG outside fitness evaluations
not_confirmed.issue: BP/ECG monitor exists for PFE and contingencies; no confirmed routine daily/weekly schedule.

not_confirmed.name: CSA Bio-Monitor (Astroskin) wearing schedule
not_confirmed.issue: Parameters confirmed (ECG, BP, breathing, skin temp, SpO2, activity); wearing schedule per protocol, not public.
